agents.notes: Primary authority for all signing, verification, and message-protection logic. Must review any contract that handles EIP-712 or ECDSA.
Reviews all DEX integrations and yield-strategy contracts. Calculates APY projections using Kelly criterion for position sizing.
Ensures quorum bounds (1–20%) are respected and all governance proposals are correctly formatted before on-chain submission.
Manages all NFT deployments, metadata standards, and legal-document CID references for RWA tokens. Coordinates with nexus-treasury-ops on rental income streams.
Responsible for the MQL5 → Chainlink → on-chain oracle adapter. Uses TWAP with 15-minute window to resist oracle manipulation.
Manages multi-sig threshold configuration, Aave V3 yield deposits, and USDC stable reserves. All treasury actions above MULTISIG_THRESHOLD require guardian co-sign.
Has veto authority on any contract deployment. Runs Slither on every PR that touches .sol files. All high/critical findings must be resolved before merge.
Ensures all HTML pages are self-contained, framework-free, and wire to live contract reads via ethers.js eth_call. No external CSS frameworks unless pre-existing.
Owns the nexus-signal-bus WebSocket server. Routes all on-chain contract events to dashboards. Coordinates with nexus-frontend-ux for WebSocket client integration.
Provides MQL5 signal feeds as inputs to the Chainlink oracle adapter. Calculates optimal reinvestBps for the FractalVault using Kelly criterion: f* = (bp - q) / b.
